luiskr.com / website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing / determineLandscapeRatio

function determineLandscapeRatio(items): string | null;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts:244

Calculates the majority landscape aspect ratio key ('16:9' | '21:9' | '32:9') among the landscape items in the list. Compares each item's width/height ratio against the 16:9, 21:9, and 32:9 target ratios and selects the mode (majority proportion).

Parameters

items

CarouselItem[]

List of slide descriptors.

Returns

string | null

The majority aspect ratio key ('16:9', '21:9', '32:9'), or null if no landscape items.
